balls.text: almost a yorker outside off. Samson gives it all he has and drills it back past the bowler. Nissanka sprawls to his right from long off and saves two. CSK finish with 212; Samson finishes unbeaten on 115 off 56!
on the bounce to long on! Juicy full toss just outside off but Dube cannot cash in. Shanks it towards long on, who does well to get his body in the way
smashed! Mukesh misses the yorker outside off on the shorter side, and Dube climbs into it. He goes through the line and bludgeons it over Samson's head!
low full toss speared into middle stump. Samson clears his front leg and hoicks it to deep mid wicket. Just a single
zipped in very full outside off. Dube tries to hit it too hard, while also fighting the angle, and scuffs it to long off
Dube joins in on the party now! Back of a length outside off and that is in Dube's arc. He lines it up and mauls it over long on!
pick the bones out of this one! Slower ball outside off and this lands short of being a yorker. In the slot and Samson launches it over wide long on!
off-pace again, dropping on a dime near the blockhole. On middle and leg, and Dube can only tug it towards deep mid wicket
another top slower yorker. Dips outside off and Dube cannot get under it. Pushes it to long off's right and ambles back for a brace
off-pace and dug in short on middle and off. Dube has a wild mow at it but is again too early into his stroke. Only swats away a few flies
superb dipping slower yorker, honing into leg stump. Dube is a week early into his flick and the ball rolls off the boot towards the bowler
Dube gets one away too! Not fully in control but Dube will not care an iota. Slower full ball on leg. Dube heaves at it and drags it into the long leg fence!
oh, hello, where has this been all along?! Attempted yorker on middle and off. Samson brings out the reverse-lap and nails it over short third!

has Samson got bat on it?! The umpire says yes, and Samson brings up a sumptuous hundred in front of thousands of adoring CSK fans! And he punches the air, and that is because a weight may have been lifted off his shoulders. Yorker speared into leg. Samson gets turned inside out but manufactures an outside edge that hurtles past short third. Samson is delighted. He takes off his helmet to soak in the applause, but he needs to now help CSK finish with a flourish!
nails the yorker, even with a left-hander on strike. Zoning into middle and Dube flicks it towards deep mid wicket
very full on middle and off. Samson cannot get under this either and clinks it out to long off. Mhatre is being retired out, btw Dube coming in at four.
right up in the blockhole, finishing just outside off. Samson gets his bat down in time but cannot do much with it otherwise. Played back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and off. Mhatre opens up his stance and hoicks it to long on

has Samson nicked this?! Samson is unmoved, as is the umpire, but Rahul is very interested! Slower ball on a full length outside off. Samson seemed to swish at thin air. Rahul was initially very upbeat but could not convince his skipper to go upstairs. Flat line on UltraEdge, so the right decision from DC, as it turns out!
very wide and very full again. Mhatre can only plonk it into the off side
dipping wide yorker nailed to perfection. Samson jams down on it and clinks it out into the off side
hard length outside off. Mhatre sits deep in his crease and shanks it to long on
slower ball on a full length wide outside off. Samson reaches out and drives it towards sweeper cover
zipped in full on middle and off. Mhatre tugs it to deep mid wicket and has to settle for a single
crafty, crafty batting! Mukesh misses the wide yorker on the shorter side and pays the price. Samson uses his bat like a sword and knifes it over backward point!
length ball hung up a mile outside off. Left alone by Samson and called a wide

shanked to long on, but Miller grasses a chance now! Well, that is a collector's item. Full outside off. Mhatre cannot get under it fully and cloths it to long on. Miller lunges forward but cannot quite make it stick!

another mix-up but Mhatre survives again! Right in the blockhole outside off. Mhatre squezes it out to backward point. Sets off for the single and almost has a mid-pitch conversation with his partner. Kuldeep lines up his throw at the batter's end and misses
very full again, zoning into off. Samson cannot get under it and clinks it to long on
excellent yorker just outside off. Samson gets his bat down in time and chalks it into the off side, via a deflection off his body
full just outside off. Mhatre gets forward and razes it towards long off. Just a single
into the blockhole on off. Mhatre digs it out towards extra cover and keeps strike
length outside off. Samson planst his front foot and powers it on the bounce to long off
the runs are flowing beautifully now! Full and wide, and Samson has an answer to this too. He throws the kitchen sink at it and scythes it past backward point!
Samson wants a piece of Natarajan too! Banged half-way down outside off and this sits up just the way Samson wants it to. He gets on top of the bounce and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
zipped in very full on off. Mhatre jams down on it and drills it on the bounce to long off
Mhatre brings up his half-century in style! Slower ball bashed into the track on off. Mhatre a tad early into it but he still manages to shovel it over deep mid wicket!
back of a length on off. Mhatre lets the ball come to him before knocking it to long on
well, the intent arrives now, and the ball flies! Flighted up a touch outside off but in the slot. Mhatre gets down on one knee and wallops it over wide long on!
fired in full on the pads. Samson comes forward and pushes it to deep mid wicket
back of a length on the stumps. Mhatre hangs back and stabs it to long on
back of a length on the pads. Samson happy to nudge it to deep mid wicket and take a single
back of a length on leg. Mhatre tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
slower ball on a full length outside off. Mhatre tips it to extra cover and scampers across to the other end
pace-on, back of a length outside off. Skips off the surface and Mhatre, reaching out for it, is beaten for pace
slow dipping low full toss wide outside off. Mhatre wafts at it and jams it off the inside edge into his body
pick that one out too, says Mhatre! Off-pace but right in the slot outside off. Mhatre spots the variation early and pumps it into the sightscreen!
edged and four vital runs for CSK! Slower ball on a length outside off. Mhatre goes chasing after it and gets a healthy nick that loops past the keeper!
shortish outside off. Mhatre dangles his bat and chops it off the under-edge towards the keeper
poetry in motion! This is a shot of the highest calibre. On a length outside off. Samson gets his hands through the ball from a still base and creams it over extra cover!
back of a length on the stumps. Eased down the ground
shorter on off. Samson winds up and thunders it back at the bowler, and his fingers are going through the wringer here. Diverted to long on
fullish on middle and leg. Mhatre comes onto the front foot and chips it just over the bowler. Kuldeep might have gotten a fingertip to it.
skied a mile up, and it has just enough on it! Floaty full ball outside off. Mhatre has an almighty slog at it and seems to miscue it. Has just enough sauce to get it over Stubbs at long on!
fullish on the pads. Samson gets down on one knee and heaves it towards deep backward square leg
low full toss just outside off. Samson comes forward and drives it towards long on
bashed in shorter outside off and this sails over the batter's head. Left alone and called a wide
safe again! Slower ball banged in short outside off. Mhatre reaches out for it and spoons it just over backward point
off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Samson dabs it to short third and looks at his partner, who nods and charges across
Samson lands his first haymaker! First six of the innings too. Juicy full toss just outside off. Samson latches onto it and dumps it over deep mid wicket!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Mhatre presses half forward and pushes it towards sweeper cover
four to begin the over! That is more like it from Mhatre. Short and wide. Mhatre throws his hands at it and flays it past backward point!
length just outside off. Mhatre eases it to long on and keeps strike
back of a length on off. Samson stays well leg side of the ball and cuts it towards sweeper cover
insult to injury! A touch short on middle stump. Samson gives himself room and forehands it over the bowler's head!

DC with more sloppiness in the field, and this time, Samson is let off the hook! Slowed up on a length outside off. Samson looks to go inside-out and scuffs it towards long off. Nissanka runs forward to his left and shells it!
pushed in again, tucking up the batter. Mhatre works it towards deep square leg

oh dear - a terrible mix-up but Rahul might have fluffed his lines too! Back of a length just outside off. Mhatre jabs it towards extra cover and sets off. Samson does not move a muscle at the other end and Mhatre has to retreat. Rahul fumbles and cannot take the bails off in time. Reprieve for Mhatre!

full and wide, and a smidgen beyond the tramlines on the off side. Left alone and called a wide, and Mukesh has convinced Axar to review. And Mukesh is right. There is a very small part of the ball inside the tramlines, and the wide call has been reversed!
length ball hung up wide outside off. Samson has a big waft at it and chalks it off the toe-end towards short third

angled in full on the stumps. Samson drills a straight drive back past the bowler. The call is for two and Mhatre has to scramble to make the second. Good work by Rizvi, diving to his left from long on and then getting the throw away. Had Mukesh gathered the ball cleanly, Mhatre might have been in trouble...
back of a length on middle and off. Mhatre stands up on his toes and punches it to long on
dug in shorter outside off. Mhatre jumps up onto his toes and jabs it towards extra cover

a maiden half-century in yellow for Samson! The first of many, he and the CSK faithful will hope. Full and sliding down leg. Samson tucks it towards deep backward square leg, and that single is met with a huge roar. This crowd has taken to their new signing, and he has repaid that faith so far tonight!
right in the gap, and Mhatre has his first boundary! Marginally short outside off. Mhatre hops back, creates room and pummels it between long on and deep mid wicket!
back of a length on middle and off. Samson hops back and pulls it powerfully towards deep mid wicket
shortish outside off. Mhatre sits deep in his crease and tugs it towards long on
googly on a back of a length outside off. Samson goes back and flat-bats it to long off
floated up full outside off. Samson comes forward and prods it towards extra cover
length ball on leg. Mhatre stays back and punches it towards long on to keep things ticking
just over! On a fullish length just outside off. Stops a little in the surface and Mhatre plonks it off the leading edge beyond the bowler. Keeps strike
fired in fuller on off. Samson drives it towards long off and takes the single
flighted up full outside off. Samson stretches forward and pokes it towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and off. Mhatre bunts it to long on and gets off the mark

miscued and taken! Axar puts Gaikwad out of his misery! A painstaking innings comes to an end. Back of a length on middle and leg. Skids through and Gaikwad, shaping for the pull, is rushed into it. Cloths it high up and deep mid wicket does the rest. Chepauk goes silent but from an immediate CSK POV, this might not be the worst outcome, given how much Gaikwad was struggling to up the tempo!
length outside off. Samson waits in his crease and knocks it to long off
slower ball on a full length outside off. Samson reaches out for it and drills it towards sweeper cover
deft touch! Back of a length outside off. Samson sits deep in his crease and plays it right under his eyes, gliding it fine of short third!
off-pace and quite full outside off. Gaikwad digs it out enough to extra cover's left for a single
slower ball on a length outside off. Samson tries to hit it too hard and scuffs it into the cover region
slow, short, wide and punished! Sits up invitingly and Samson has no second-thoughts. He throws his hands at it and blisters it through point!
angled in full on middle and off. Gaikwad tips it to mid on and saunters across to the other end
shortish just outside off and this skips through. Samson shapes for the cut but is beaten for pace
over the top again! Slot ball outside off. Samson plants his front foot and goes through the line, lofting it cleanly over mid off. One bounce and into the fence!
shortish outside off. Gaikwad gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards sweeper cover
fullish just outside off. Samson nurdles it into the point region and calls his skipper through for the single
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and clips it through the wide mid on region. Retrieved by mid on, meaning the CSK skipper has to settle for three
hard length just outside off and this cramps the batter for room. Gaikwad dabs it straight to backward point
this is another gorgeous stroke! Darted in full on leg. Samson moves to the leg side, peels the outer cover off the ball and carves it over extra cover!
back of a length on middle and off. Samson stays back and pats it into the off side
up and over! Samson seems to be batting on a different pitch to Gaikwad. Tossed up full on middle. Samson backs away and lifts it nonchalantly over extra cover!
slower on a length on off. Comes in with the angle and Gaikwad drops it into the off side for another single
pulls the length back outside off after seeing the batter advance. Gaikwad pokes it back to the bowler
Gaikwad breaks the shackles! Shortish and angling into off. Gaikwad steps out to the leg side early and crashes it through point!
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad hangs back and works it towards deep square leg
full, wide and Gaikwad misses out. Gets good purchase on his square drive but cannot get it past cover point
hard length just outside off. Gaikwad gets a half stride in before pushing it towards mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Moves away late and Samson gets squared up, prodding the ball behind point for a single
shot! Marginally short just outside off. Samson stands tall, opens up his front hip and slams it over mid on. Lands just short of the fence!
back of a length just outside off. Kicks up a little and Gaikwad plonks it to mid off before haring across to the other end
classic Samson! Full on off. Samson takes a step deep into his crease, stays still, shows the maker's name and cracks it back past the bowler!
four more! Length ball sliding into the pads and Samson puts it away. He uses the pace and the angle, and glances it into the fine leg fence!
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad takes a step down and bunts it to mid on for a quick single
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad presses half forward and pats it towards extra cover
back of a length just outside off. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and stabs it to mid on
back of a length just outside off, shaping away. Samson waits on it and taps it just behind point

back of a length on off. Samson lets the ball come to him before turning it into the mid wicket region. A bit of hesitation on the run but no damage done in the end. Natarajan, who nearly over-ran it, did well to recover too
short and wide again. Samson lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
back of a length just outside off. Samson gets up on his toes and meets it right under his eyes
first boundary for Samson! Too short and too wide outside off. Samson throws his hands at it and slices it past short third!
back of a length outside off. Gaikwad steps down the track and punches it to mid off. Scampers across to complete the single
length outside off. Gaikwad gets a half stride in before pushing it towards extra cover

off the mark straightaway. On a length outside off. A bit of shape away and Samson covers it, punching it on the up between extra cover and cover point. Deep point comes around, dives to his right and saves a run

taken at short third, and that is a fitting end to this contest! CSK are on the board at the fourth time of asking and they have won at Chepauk for the first time in seven attempts! Pushed across the batter outside off. Ngidi wafts at it and the ball flies off the outside edge. Gobbled up neatly by Gurjapneet, and cue the celebrations now. More relief than anything, given the history of this franchise, and this has comfortably been their best performance this season!
low full toss outside off. Ngidi throws his hands at it and chips it over extra cover fo a couple of runs
full and wide outside off. Ngidi keeps swinging like a rusty gate and seems to get a nick on it. Kamboj appeals, only to soon realize this was a Free hit. Umpire has a smile on his face too!
speared across the batter outside off. Quite full too and Ngidi, swinging at it with all his might, does not make contact. But Kamboj has overstepped. You have got to be kidding me!
darted in very full on middle and leg. Natarajan clinks it out to long on
back of a length outside off. Natarajan wafts at it and misses it by a fair margin

popped to extra cover, and CSK are almost there now! Pushed in full on middle stump. Kuldeep steps out and gives himself room to go inside out. Shanks it completely, though, and Brevis, moving to his right at extra cover, sends Kuldeep on his way!
another slower ball, on a back of a length on middle and off. Kuldeep hacks it to deep mid wicket and keeps strike for the start of the 20th
slower ball on a length outside off. Kuldeep shuffles across before prodding it towards the bowler
shortish on middle and leg. Ngidi hops around his crease before drop-kicking it into the square leg region

plonked to mid off, and Overton is having a night to remember under the Chepauk lights! Hard length on middle and off, bowled at around 144 clicks. Stubbs looks to muscle it over mid off but the ball comes onto him much quicker than he expects. Off the higher part of the blade and Noor, running back from mid off, snares it. Overton is pumped, and over the moon. The crowd are too, and this could be the game right here!

nails the slower wide yorker. Stubbs swishes and misses, and the wide has been called. Overton immediately asks fore the review, and Gaikwad obliges. This could be a shrewd call. Ball inside the tramlines. Decision overturned. Dot ball!
banged in short and this slides down leg a touch. Stubbs cannot catch up with it but he does see the umpire indulging in some exercise

slower ball on a full length just outside off. Kuldeep plays all around it and the ball rolls off his pad into the on side. Overton fielded it on his follow-through and flicked it at the stumps but could not stop the single
juicy full toss outside off, and Stubbs bulldozes it down the ground! Free swing through the line and Stubbs gets ample punch on this to send it hurtling past long off!
well well! Zipped in very full on middle. Kuldeep plays the reverse-ramp, perhaps with the back of the bat. Bobbles towards deep third, who is very fine
very full on leg. Stubbs jams down on it and digs it out towards mid on. Takes the single this time

oh dear - that is average fielding on the fence! Length ball hung up wide outside off. Stubbs throws himself at it and slices it towards sweeper cover. Noor does not account for the spin on the second/third bounce and lets it through!
another top wide yorker. Stubbs shapes for the reverse-scoop but scuffs it into the off side. Denies the single, with Kuldeep at the other end. Here we go. Again
nails the wide yorker first up. Stubbs cannot get under it and clinks it off the toe-end towards extra cover
low full toss just outside off. Stubbs pushes it to long off and keeps strike
full on middle and off. Stubbs drives it uppishly past the bowler, and he has enough time to race back for two. A brilliant half-century under pressure by Stubbs!
going, going, gone! Stubbs is keeping this alive! Half-tracker on middle and off. Stubbs gets his front hip out of the way and whacks it over deep mid wicket!
Stubbs keeps fighting! Slower ball on a shortish length outside off. Stubbs throws his hands at it and slices it past backward point!
dug in short outside off. Kuldeep shuffles across and tugs it towards deep mid wicket. A fumble on the fence but no extra runs conceded by Kamboj
short and climbing up on leg. Stubbs opens up his stance and hoicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs stays back and stabs it towards deep square leg
hard length on off. Kuldeep opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third

Nabi swings for the hills, and he only finds Akeal at extra cover, who pulls off a stunning grab! Akeal did misjudge it at the start and had to redeem himself, much like Hetmyer yesterday. Length ball outside off. Nabi wanted to smash it into next week but miscued it terribly. Akeal ran in too much initially but then had the awareeness to leap and take it over his head. DC seven down now!
shortish outside off. Stubbs stands up tall and hacks it to deep mid wicket
hard length outside off. Stubbs gets up on his toes and taps it towards backward point
short and wide outside off. Stubbs wafts at it and misses. Wants the wide but the umpire says no
what a way to announce yourself! Fired in full outside off. Nabi plants his front foot and crunches it past extra cover!

sliced straight to sweeper cover, and Noor is on the board in his fourth game of the season! Throws it up outside off and dares Ashutosh to go inside-out. Ashutosh takes up the invite but falls well short. Cuts across it too much and Kamboj, running in off the deep point fence, does the rest!
clean as a whistle! Ashutosh turning it on now! Lobbed up into the slot on middle and off. Ashutosh gives himself ample room and clobbers it a mile over long off!

full ball outside leg. Ashutosh shapes for the reverse and misses it to get pinged on the back leg. Definitely pitched outside leg but CSK, for some reason, have reviewed this. Strange call. The third umpire looks at UltraEdge, and there is a spike too. CSK burn a review!
serious power! Floated up full on middle and leg. Ashutosh gives himself room and blasts it over the non-striker's head!
dragged down outside off. Stubbs hops back and cuts it towards sweeper cover. He is livid with himself for having found the fielder
length ball pushed across the batter outside off. Ashutosh shimmies to the off side and swipes at it, only to connect with fresh air
hard length on middle and leg. Not much Ashutosh can do with this and he prods it towards the bowler
back of a length outside off. Stubbs backs away and cuts it towards sweeper cover

nicked and four! Shortish outside off. Stubbs flays at it and the ball flies off the outside edge. Not the greatest effort of all time from Khaleel at short third (to his left), and Gurjapneet is not best pleased!
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs gets on top of the bounce and razes it behind point. Back for another brace
hard length on middle and leg. Ashutosh taps it into the point region and saunters across to the other end
on the shorter side again, outside off. Ashutosh opens his bat face this time and glides it on the bounce to deep third
up. up and away! Length ball straying onto the pads. Ashutosh gets inside the line, uses his wrists and whips it over fine leg!
hard length on middle and leg. Stubbs hangs back and knocks it to long on
in the air but well short of fine leg! Banged in short on middle and leg. Ashutosh looks for that pick-up pull but makes a mess of it. Miscues it so badly that it falls well in front of Khaleel

hot knife through butter, and Overton is at it again! Hard length on leg, and this seems to deck back in just a smidgen. Miller has no clue about it. Beaten for pace (this was bowled at more than 145kph) and beaten by the movement too. Cut in half, and the leg-stump bail goes for a toss. Miller bewildered as he walks off, but this crowd is now having a ball at Chepauk!
back of a length outside off. Miller a tad early on the cut and he scuffs it towards mid off
slow, short and wide outside off. Stubbs goes back and across before slapping it past extra cover for a couple of runs
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Stubbs gets on top of the bounce and punches it to sweeper cover's right. Back for another brace
Stubbs on the move! Off-pace again but this too is in the slot outside off. Stubbs uses his long levers and smacks it over long off!
slower ball on a back of a length just outside off. Stubbs stabs it enough to long on's right and tears back for two
back of a length just outside off. Miller drops it into the off side and canters across
off-pace and into the track outside off. Stubbs rises with the bounce and punches it towards sweeper cover
starts off with a short ball down leg. Stubbs gets inside the line and lets it go. Called a wide
shot! Flighted up and this is in the slot outside off. Miller plants his front foot and boshes it over the bowler's head!
speared in full but down leg again. This time, though, Samson gets something more significant on it. Just a solitary wide
short and dispatched! Fractionally short on off. Miller spots the length early, rocks back and belts it over deep mid wicket!
very full just outside off. Stubbs plants his front foot and digs it out towards long off
sprays this down leg. Samson cannot gather too and DC get a couple of bonus runs
leg-spinner on a length on leg. Stubbs reads it off the pitch and works it towards deep mid wicket
floated up fuller outside off. Stubbs gets forward and drills it straight to extra cover
googly on a length on middle and leg. Stubbs is late to pick it and stabs it back to the bowler
zipped in full on middle and off. Stubbs squared up a little but manages to pat it towards sweeper cover for a single
Stubbs has had enough of these streaky singles! Off-pace on a back of a length outside off. Stubbs picks it early, goes through the line and hoists it over mid off!

another mix-up but CSK do not capitalize! Back of a length outside off. Stubbs' turn to jab it to extra cover. Miller hell-bent on the single but Stubbs is not. Miller stranded half-way down had Akeal hit the stumps

chaos in the middle! Slower ball on a length outside off. Miller taps it to backward point. Says no to the single (ah, here we go again), but then there is a misfield. Stubbs, in trying to return initially, has to then put on his skates again. Pulls out a full-length dive and it may have been interesting with a direct hit
on a length just outside off. Stubbs tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. Stubbs hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards backward point
floate dup full on leg. Stubbs reaches out for it in front and chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Miller stays back and pokes it into the cover region
another googly but this is dropped short too. Stubbs hops back and jabs it towards sweeper cover
fired in full just outside off. Miller lunges forward and knocks it to long on
googly on a back of a length outside off. Stubbs punches it off the back foot to long off and opens his account
slider on a length on middle and leg. Miller goes back and works it towards deep mid wicket

goes a mile up again, and Brevis was not going to drop it. Not in a million years! This hit-the-deck ploy working wonders for the hosts. Just outside off. Rizvi looks to swivel and dump it over deep square leg. Miscues it right off the toe-end, though, and Brevis accepts the offering with glee, while stationed a few yards inside the fence. CSK in control now!
short and wide. Sticks a little in the surface, though, and Rizvi scuffs it towards backward point
hard length on leg, and this shapes in late. Miller stabs it towards extra cover and hares across to the other end
sharp short ball but this is down leg. Miller late on the pull and misses it. Called a wide, though
back of a length outside off. Rizvi waits on it before running it down to deep third
back of a length outside off. Rizvi gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
Overton begins with a bumper of his own. On middle and leg, and this skips through. Rizvi ducks under it
back of a length on off. Miller, hanging back, is happy to block it into the off side
shortish outside off. Miller jumps up onto his toes before jabbing it towards extra cover
sharp short ball, tucking up the batter on middle. Bowled at 138kph but it rushes Miller, who defends hurriedly into the off side
back of a length on middle and leg. Rizvi gets squared up and prods it into the cover region
on the shorter side again, on off. Miller hops up onto his toes and fends it behind point to open his account
oh dear! Gurjapneet gets carried away and bangs it half-way down again. This one sails over the batter's head and Samson needed a ladder to get to that!

is that a bird, is that a plane?! No, it is Sarfaraz flying through the air! And a first-ball wicket for the left-arm seamer. Banged in short outside off. Axar cannot keep his cut down but he absolutely laces it towards backward point. Sarfaraz throws himself to his right and plucks it out of thin air. Runs around like he has just won a medal in the 100m event at the Olympics, and a moment of magic hands CSK their third scalp!
back of a length outside off. Rizvi hangs back and chops it off the under-edge towards the keeper
slanted in full on middle and off. Rizvi comes forward and drives it crisply to mid on
off the mark in pristine style! Over-pitched outside off and Rizvi does not miss out. He leans into the drive and threads it between extra cover and cover point!
back of a length just outside off. Axar opens his bat face and runs it down to deep third

second time is the charm for Kamboj, and Chepauk comes to life! Khaleel breathes a sigh of relief, as do thousands clad in yellow at the stadium. Full on middle and off, and this shapes back in a shade. Holds in the surface too and Nissanka, checking his drive, pops it straight to Brevis. CSK getting their teeth stuck in now!

Khaleel puts down a regulation chance! CSK could easily have gone back-to-back here. Not the best delivery Kamboj has bowled tonight. Full and down leg. Nissanka flicks it towards Khaleel, and it is too hot to handle for the pacer, moving to his right

change of angle works immediately! Bashed into the track, and this slants into off. Rahul wants to swipe it over mid wicket but the lack of room means he cannot free his arms fully. A little rushed too and he splices it tamely to Overton at mid wicket. First wicket for Khaleel this season, and some respite for CSK!
dug in short on middle and off. Nissanka gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
this is fodder for Nissanka! Half-way down again outside off and Nissanka has all the time in the world to crash it over extra cover!

oh, what a magnificent effort that is! Banged in short on middle and leg. Nissanka whacks it towards deep backward square leg, where Noor channels his inner LeBron James and leaps to his right. Catches it and in one motion, pushes it into play, even as he lands beyond the fence. Top work!

back of a length on leg. Nissanka gives himself room and heaves it over mid wicket. Overton moves to his left on the fence but fumbles as he slides. Does just enough to release the ball before his foot touches the cushion
back of a length just outside off. Nissanka presses half forward and taps it towards extra cover
back of a length and sneaking into the pads. Nissanka turns it behind square and retains strike
Nissanka goes again, and gets four this time! Dragged down outside off. Nissanka has a mow at it and while he does not time it as well as the previous ball, he has enough on it to clear mid wicket!
sit back and admire! This is a Nissanka special. A tad short outside off. Nissanka rocks back and pounds it over deep mid wicket!
banged in short outside off. Rahul has a swipe at it and drags it towards long leg
hard length, pitching just outside off and nipping in. Rahul has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside edge into his pad
greeted with a boundary! Length ball speared into the pads. Rahul walks down the track and helps it into the fine leg fence!
arm-ball, sliding into the pads. Nissanka, though, cannot get it away. Glances it straight to short fine leg
back of a length, slanting into middle and leg. Nissanka, cramped for room, jams it into the off side
back of a length, angling into the pads. Rahul tucks it towards deep mid wicket
this is lovely batting! Rahul knows the over-correction is coming. He knows the conventional off-spinner is coming too. Dances down to this length ball on middle and creams it over mid off!
catch it is the cry, but no one is going to catch that! Dragged down on middle and off. Rahul picks the arm-ball, backs away and thumps it over mid off!
arm-ball, on a back of a length outside off. Nissanka stays back and chops it towards backward point
dug in short on middle and leg. Nissanka gets up on his toes and hacks it towards deep backward square leg
full on the pads, and tickled away! Too easy for Nissanka again, and he gets enough on it to find the fine leg fence!
up and over again! In the slot and laced with width. Nissanka reaches out for it and lofts it over mid off!
back of a length outside off. Nissanka scuffs it into the off side. Might have held in the surface a touch
picked up and deposited a mile back! Shortish outside leg and that is a hit-me ball. Nissanka gets inside the line and helps it well over the fine leg fence!
back of a length, angling across the batter outside off. Rahul runs it down to deep backward point
arm-ball, on a back of a length outside off. Nissanka gets back and cuts it towards cover point
fired in on a length on off. Rahul stays back and punches it to extra cover. Sets off for the single and makes it, despite Sarfaraz's direct hit
shortish on middle and off. Rahul sits back, winds up and heaves it towards square leg. Noor sprawls to his left and reins it in
back of a length on off. Nissanka pushes it towards mid wicket and gets it just past mid wicket. And Akeal has overstepped again. This is ordinary cricket!
shorter outside off, spinning away a touch again. Nissanka jabs it towards cover point, where Kamboj tumbles to his right and saves four
back of a length just outside off. Straightens a touch and Nissanka, hanging back, taps it towards extra cover
Nissanka is up and running! Arm-ball, also dragged down on middle and off. Nissanka picks it up and hammers it over mid wicket!
back of a length outside off. Spins away, after sticking in the surface, and Nissanka scuffs it into the off side. But oh dear - Akeal has overstepped...
